subject: Credits request for GreenfieldJS CI and docs inference
messages:
From: Evan Torres <evan@greenfieldjs.org>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenfieldJS Maintainers <maintainers@greenfieldjs.org>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: CI / docs inference credits for GreenfieldJS

Hi Hannah,

Hope youre well — Im Evan, one of the lead maintainers for GreenfieldJS (open-source UI toolkit). Weve been experimenting with Redwood for on-demand docs generation and CI checks that run lightweight model inference (mainly embeddings + templated generation). Our community has a small roster of active contributors but heavy CI runs are starting to hit our budget as we scale docs and automated PR summaries.

Would Redwood be open to providing a maintainer trial allocation (self-serve credits) to help cover CI inference for the next 3–6 months? A rough ask would be 200k tokens worth of generation + embeddings (~$400–$600 credit range) so we can iterate without throttling contributors. If you need metrics Ive attached a short PDF with monthly CI costs and a CSV with the current maintainer list.

Were also a recipient of a small community grant from OSSFund (ccd here: Liang Wu) and happy to include Redwood in our contributor sponsors list.

Thanks for considering — quick answers welcome, were trying to finalize our next-quarter budget.

Best,
Evan Torres
Lead Maintainer — GreenfieldJS
Evan@greenfieldjs.org

Attachments: greenfieldjs-metrics-202601.pdf, maintainer-list.csv
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Evan Torres <evan@greenfieldjs.org>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: CI / docs inference credits for GreenfieldJS

Hi Evan — thanks for the note and for the attachments, they were helpful. Quick clarifying questions so we can route this to grants/PLG credits correctly: 

- Confirming this is primarily CI for embeddings + light generation for PR summaries and docs builds (no PII processing)?
- Preferred duration: 3 months vs 6 months? We can split a larger allocation into a front-loaded tranche + renewal.
- Who should be the single point of contact for the redemption link (email that will claim the code)?
- Do you want Redwood listed as an official sponsor or just a donor credit in your README?

Ccd Dev Patel from our community credits team to expedite. If youre comfortable, can you also paste the GitHub org link in a reply so I can attach it to the internal request ticket?

If everything looks good we typically issue a self-serve promo code that the maintainer redeems in our dashboard.

Thanks — Hannah Schmitt
Community Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

On Fri, Jan 10, 2026 at 09:14 AM Evan Torres <evan@greenfieldjs.org> wrote:
> Hi Hannah,
> 
> Hope youre well — Im Evan...
From: Evan Torres <evan@greenfieldjs.org>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Liang Wu <liang@ossfund.org>, GreenfieldJS Maintainers <maintainers@greenfieldjs.org>
Date: Mon, 13 Jan 2026 08:29:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: CI / docs inference credits for GreenfieldJS

Thanks Hannah — answers below and added a GitHub link.

- Use case: Yes, embeddings for search, small-generation templates for PR summaries (max 200 tokens per run). No PII in public CI runs; contributors sometimes run private PR previews but weve flagged those in the attached csv.
- Duration: 6 months preferred if possible; gives us runway to measure impact.
- Redemption contact: maintainers@greenfieldjs.org (well coordinate who claims).
- Sponsorship: Wed love Redwood to be listed on our sponsors page and in the repo README (logo + link).

GitHub: https://github.com/greenfieldjs/greenfield

Attached again: greenfieldjs-metrics-202601.pdf (monthly cost breakout) and maintainer-list.csv

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Evan

> On Fri, Jan 10, 2026 at 11:02 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Approved: GreenfieldJS maintainer credits (self-serve issuance)

Hi Evan / GreenfieldJS team — happy to confirm we approved a maintainer trial allocation today. Summary below and next steps: 

Allocation: 250,000 token-equivalent credits (estimated value $550)
Term: 6 months (expires 2026-07-15)
Redemption: self-serve promo code valid for the GitHub org maintainers@greenfieldjs.org
Promo code: GFJ-2026-APPROVED
Claim link (one-click): https://app.redwood.com/credits/redeem?code=GFJ-2026-APPROVED
Notes: No access to private data required; tokens limited to non-PII inference as described. If you need an increased allocation we can open a follow-on grant review in 60 days.

Weve ccd Marissa Cole from Partner Ops to make sure the promo code and the HubSpot record (linked below) get logged for reporting. Marissa, please attach the approval PDF to the account and set the HubSpot deal stage to "Sponsored - Maintainer Credits".

Related links: https://github.com/greenfieldjs/greenfield | HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/contacts/record/12345

Attachments: approved-credits-notice.pdf

Happy to jump on a quick 15-minute call if you want help redeeming. Congrats — excited to see Redwood power your docs & CI.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Community Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
